caption: The drawing depicts a single spurred object, likely a cowboy spur, positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The spur has a brown leather strap with visible stitching and a metallic buckle, along with a large, rounded brass or gold-colored stud. The main body of the spur is metallic, appearing silvery-gray and brass, with engraved or embossed decorative patterns on the arm. The rowel (the rotating wheel at the end) is composed of multiple evenly spaced, straight metal spokes radiating from a central hub, also metallic in color. Shadows below the object suggest the object is lying on a flat surface, with no other items or background features present. The artist’s signature, "R.W.G. Taylor," is visible in small text toward the lower right.
title: Spur
